caption: The drawing depicts a textile fragment with geometric patterns rendered in predominantly blue and rust-red colors. The textile is rectangular, with fringes along the right and bottom edges. The background is a rich, deep blue, while the patterns consist of rust-red motifs, including large central and corner medallions formed by stepped rectangles, as well as smaller circular and diamond shapes. The patterns are bordered and intersected by lines and curves, also in rust-red, forming interconnected shapes and enclosing sections of the design. The right edge of the textile shows more prominent fraying, and the transitional areas between blue and rust-red reveal some variation in color intensity, suggesting differences in the dye saturation. The textile is set against a plain, light-beige background, and the artist's name "Charles Goddarn" appears at the bottom right below the textile.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
